pages.title: Formal Proof Assistant
pages.text: Checks proofs one axiom at a time. Logic, set theory and category theory are all built here.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
Like real proof checkers, it trusts nothing it has not derived. Tedious, but every result it accepts is certain. I made three errors today; it caught all three.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (6 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Aleph Glass, Axiom Schema, Axiom of Choice, Category Lattice, Empty Set, Euler's Identity, Feynman Diagram, Formal Proof Tree, Functor Bridge, Half Turn, Hilbert Brick, Postulate Slate, Power Set, Proof Certificate...
